fact: Minister Kruah said the National ePortal, eLiberia.gov.lr, launched on 23 July 2018, is a one-stop shop for government information and automated e-services across agencies, aiming to centralise online government services.
The Liberia Revenue Authority says it launched an Online Duty-Free Application Platform where qualified individuals and institutions submit duty-free requests electronically.

Liberia's Consulate General in New York introduced online payment for all consular services on its website, including visas, passports, laissez-passer and birth affidavits, announced 16 November 2026.

Liberia's Deputy Minister for Operations said the Ministry of Mines and Energy's online application system for mineral exploration and mining licences and permits, introduced in 2026, was fully operational.
